title: Esther Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Esther 9: the thirteenth of Adar, the fall of Haman's sons, and how the days of Purim got their name.

questions.text: What happened on the day the enemies of the Jews hoped to conquer them?
questions.explanation: On that day the opposite happened: the Jews conquered those who hated them.

answers.text: The Jews conquered those who hated them

questions.text: Why did the princes and governors of the provinces help the Jews?
questions.explanation: They helped the Jews because the fear of Mordecai had fallen on them.

answers.text: The fear of Mordecai had fallen on them

questions.text: How many men did the Jews kill in the citadel of Susa, as stated in verse 6?
questions.explanation: In the citadel of Susa, the Jews killed and destroyed five hundred men.

questions.text: What did Esther ask to be done with Haman's ten sons?
questions.explanation: Esther asked that Haman's ten sons be hanged on the gallows.

answers.text: That they be hanged on the gallows
That they be sent into exile
That they be set over the provinces

questions.text: On which day of the month did the Jews in Susa rest and make a day of feasting?
questions.explanation: The Jews in Susa assembled on the thirteenth and fourteenth days, and on the fifteenth day they rested and feasted.

questions.text: According to verse 19, who make the fourteenth day of Adar a day of gladness and feasting?
questions.explanation: The Jews of the villages, who live in the unwalled towns, make the fourteenth day of Adar a day of gladness and feasting.

answers.text: The Jews in the citadel of Susa
The priests serving in the temple
The king's eunuchs in the palace
The Jews of the villages in unwalled towns

questions.text: Which days did Mordecai tell the Jews to keep every year?
questions.explanation: Mordecai wrote that they should keep the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month Adar yearly.

answers.text: The fourteenth and fifteenth days of Adar
The first and second days of Sivan
Only the thirteenth day of Adar
The seventh day of every month

questions.explanation: Haman had cast "Pur", that is the lot, to consume and destroy the Jews.

questions.text: What did they call these days, from the word "Pur"?
questions.explanation: They called these days "Purim", from the word "Pur".

questions.text: Whose daughter was Esther the queen, according to verse 29?
questions.explanation: Verse 29 calls her Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail.
